# Solana Balances API

> Solana balances API: fetch SPL & Token-2022 holdings with Vybe balances and metadata, and live USD portfolio values for any Solana wallet.

Live demo of the Vybe Solana API. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## Demo
- [Solana Balances API](https://solana-balances-api.vybenetwork.com/): Solana balances API: fetch SPL & Token-2022 holdings with Vybe balances and metadata, and live USD portfolio values for any Solana wallet.

## Docs

- [Token Details API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_token_details_v4.md)
- [Trader PnL API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_wallet_pnl_v4.md)
- [Top Traders API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_top_traders_v4.md)
- [DeFi Positions API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_defi_accounts_v4_proxy.md)
